title: nbn service disruption - Howlong, NSW
current_summary:
Some nbn services in Howlong, NSW have been affected since about 11:43 am AEDT on 1 November 2026. No restoration estimate has been provided.

A power outage in the local area is affecting the nbn equipment that serves your service. Service is expected to return once local power is restored, and nbn will then run checks on the network.

A local power outage is affecting the nbn network, resulting in service interruptions for customers. nbn is actively monitoring the situation, and once power returns, will check alarms and run network health checks to ensure stability. For details such as the Estimated Time to Restore (ETR), please reach out to your local power provider. After power is restored, nbn suggests resetting your modem and in-home devices if you continue to have issues.

nbn is working hard to resolve an unexpected network issue in your area causing a partial or total loss of connectivity to your nbn service. Using mobile data can help you stay connected if needed.

cause.reason: Local power outage affecting the nbn network
